seo.title: ROCO — Plumbing and Hydraulic Solutions
seo.description: ROCO. Solutions in plumbing, hydraulics and industrial components. Brazilian manufacturer with national presence and exports.

hero.headline: Plumbing and Hydraulic Solutions You Can Trust
hero.description: Explore the complete ROCO product line. Engineered to meet the most demanding requirements of the Brazilian industrial market.
hero.sceneAlt: Futuristic ROCO environment with cyan and amber neon lighting

about.headline: Brazilian Industry in Growth
paragraphs: ROCO is a manufacturer specialized in plumbing and hydraulic solutions, serving the market since 2014. With headquarters in Blumenau and Gaspar, Santa Catarina, we invest constantly in innovation and quality to better serve our customers.
Our operations span the entire national territory and exports to Paraguay and Bolivia. We combine industrial expertise with commitment to sustainability and best business practices.

hero.title: Welcome to ROCO
hero.subtitle: We are a Brazilian hydraulics and gas solutions industry, in constant growth, recognized for our quality, innovation and commitment to our partners.
hero.description: Here you will find all the necessary materials to complement and support your daily work as a ROCO representative.

about.title: Meet ROCO
about.body: ROCO is an industry specialized in developing hydraulic and gas installation solutions, serving the entire national territory and other countries as well. We focus on innovation, efficiency and quality in every detail of our products and processes.

catalog.title: Download our catalog
catalog.body: In the ROCO catalog you will find our entire product portfolio, with technical specifications, applications and differentials that help you serve your customers.

contacts.title: ROCO key contacts
contacts.body: To facilitate your daily communication, we provide a complete list of the most relevant ROCO contacts, including strategic departments for commercial support, logistics, marketing and administrative services.

commercialPolicy.title: ROCO Commercial Policy
commercialPolicy.body: Here you will find ROCO's commercial policy, with all guidelines, rules and conditions that guide our market performance. Reading it is essential to ensure alignment and transparency in negotiations.

logistics.title: Logistics Organizational Rules
logistics.body: This section brings together all rules and guidelines related to logistics, including deadlines, billing, shipping and operational processes. This information ensures greater efficiency and predictability in customer service.

dwSystem.title: DW System
dwSystem.subtitle: Everything you need to know
dwSystem.intro: The DW System is the primary support tool for ROCO representatives. With it you can:
dwSystem.outro: Watch the video below for a complete step-by-step guide on how to use the system.

library.title: Technical Videos and Support Materials
library.body: Whenever you need, check out our portfolio of technical videos, training materials and support content. These materials were developed to ease your daily work and strengthen your sales arguments.

closing.paragraph1: This page brings together everything you need to start your journey as a ROCO representative with confidence and clarity. Whenever a question or need arises, come back here.
closing.paragraph2: More than products, we believe in relationships, partnership and constant evolution. Welcome to the team.
